question: Q-W-S2-P
text: Ordered quantity and revenue (excl. tax) by calendar month for 2015 on one shared date axis.
interpretation: Ordered quantity (by order_date) and revenue excl. tax (by invoice_date) per calendar month of 2015 on one shared date axis.
assemble: SELECT m.month_start_date, q.ordered_quantity, q.revenue FROM months m LEFT JOIN q ON q.month_start_date = m.month_start_date ORDER BY m.month_start_date
note: One query returns orders (by order date) and revenue (by invoice date) on the shared Date table; the month axis is the Date table's own domain (dimension-only query).
